comparisons.name: news-light
comparisons.description: The leading 300 x 304 pt of the News window, Aqua: window controls, two toolbar buttons, the sidebar and its divider. The row icons and the button glyphs are masked: the example draws stand-in blocks and glyphs, not Apple's artwork.

comparisons.name: news-light-masked
comparisons.description: As news-light with the group headers and the row labels masked too, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: scores the toolbar, the buttons' bezels, the sidebar's fill, selection and divider.

comparisons.name: news-dark
comparisons.description: The leading 300 x 304 pt of the News window, Dark Aqua, where the sidebar is 234 pt wide. The row icons and the button glyphs are masked: the example draws stand-in blocks and glyphs, not Apple's artwork.

comparisons.name: news-dark-masked
comparisons.description: As news-dark with the group headers and the row labels masked too, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: scores the toolbar, the buttons' bezels, the sidebar's fill, selection and divider.

comparisons.name: voice-memos-light
comparisons.description: The top of the Voice Memos window, Aqua: the toolbar over black content, which shows through the toolbar material. The title and the Trim glyph are masked: the title is set in the fallback font and the glyph is a stand-in drawing.

comparisons.name: voice-memos-dark
comparisons.description: The top of the Voice Memos window, Dark Aqua: the toolbar over black content. The title and the Trim glyph are masked: the title is set in the fallback font and the glyph is a stand-in drawing.

comparisons.name: stocks-light
comparisons.description: The leading 400 x 70 pt of the Stocks window, Aqua: the toolbar over the 330 pt sidebar and over the content, the sidebar's fill, its half-point shade divider and the content. The Back glyph is a stand-in drawing and the search field is the app's own: both are masked.

comparisons.name: stocks-dark
comparisons.description: The leading 400 x 70 pt of the Stocks window, Dark Aqua: the toolbar is darker over the sidebar's column and fades to the title bar material about the column's edge; the divider is half a point of shade. The Back glyph and the app's search field are masked.

comparisons.name: find-my-light
comparisons.description: The leading 300 x 36 pt of the Find My window, Aqua, a chrome without a toolbar row: the window controls 8 pt from the edge and 5 pt down, over the 261 pt sidebar in Find My's fill, which the example sets through the sidebar's fill and divider variables, the two highlight rows of the window's top edge and the sidebar's plain one-point line. The map after the line is masked: the capture has Apple's map there.

comparisons.name: find-my-dark
comparisons.description: The leading 300 x 36 pt of the Find My window, Dark Aqua, a chrome without a toolbar row. The capture's window is not key, so the example's is inactive and the window controls are grey. The map after the sidebar's line is masked.

comparisons.name: rtl-light
comparisons.description: The chrome where a stylesheet sets the direction to right-to-left, Aqua, which no screenshot shows: the sidebar's column is at the right, the content at the left.

pixels.note: the sidebar's fill, in the right half (spec: Colours, sidebar background, measured)
the content, in the left half

comparisons.name: rtl-dark
comparisons.description: The chrome where a stylesheet sets the direction to right-to-left, Dark Aqua, which no screenshot shows: the toolbar's darker stretch lies over the sidebar's column at the right and is gone over the content at the left, as it is mirrored left to right.

pixels.note: the toolbar over the sidebar's column: the bar under black at 10% (spec: Colours, toolbar over the sidebar's column, measured left to right)
the toolbar over the content: the title bar's material alone

comparisons.name: inactive-light
comparisons.description: The chrome in a window that is not key, with content under the toolbar, Aqua: the toolbar is the title bar's flat inactive fill, not the translucent material, and the sidebar's selection is unchanged.
